project.name: tingting
project.description: TingTing Vietnamese trucking logistics platform — Silversea customer deployment. pnpm monorepo: backend (Express + Drizzle ORM + Casbin RBAC + WebSocket), frontend (React + Vite), shared (cross-package TS contracts), e2e (Playwright).

nodes.name: backend/Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the @tingting/backend Express API: a builder stage compiles shared+backend TypeScript with pnpm, and a minimal node:22-alpine production stage runs dist/index.js on port 3090 with Casbin policy files and Drizzle migrations bundled.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage build (builder + production); copies pruned prod node_modules from a dedicated /prod install to minimize image size.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: node:22-alpine build stage that activates pnpm 10, installs the @tingting/backend workspace, and compiles the shared and backend TypeScript packages into dist artifacts.

nodes.name: production
nodes.summary: Minimal node:22-alpine runtime stage exposing port 3090 that runs the compiled backend (node dist/index.js) with Casbin model/policy, Drizzle migrations, and BeVietnam fonts copied in.

nodes.name: frontend/Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the @tingting/frontend Vite/React SPA: a node:22-alpine build stage produces the static bundle, then an nginx:alpine runtime stage serves the dist over port 80 with a custom nginx.conf.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage build (build + nginx); nginx replaces default conf.d with frontend/nginx.conf to serve the SPA.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: node:22-alpine build stage that installs the @tingting/frontend workspace, builds the shared package, then runs pnpm build to produce the Vite static bundle in frontend/dist.

nodes.name: nginx
nodes.summary: nginx:alpine runtime stage exposing port 80 that serves the built SPA from /usr/share/nginx/html using frontend/nginx.conf as the default server config.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Root Docker build-context ignore list: excludes node_modules, dist, .git, agent config dirs, uploads, test results, plans, docs, and *.md (except README.md) so only the source needed for image builds enters the context.

nodes.name: HANDOFF.example.md
nodes.summary: Template for the per-task HANDOFF.md snapshot capturing controller, goal/scope, decisions, task-owned files, preserved concurrent changes, QA results, and the next-step blocker. HANDOFF.md itself is git-ignored transient state.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Root orchestration Makefile driving the full Silversea dev lifecycle: `make dev` brings up Postgres+Redis and runs the backend/frontend watchers; targets cover infra, migrate/generate/seed, drizzle studio, build, teardown, log tails, and the multi-step demo deploy flow to vantai.tingting.vip (build+push GHCR images, pull, migrate, recreate, health-check) without touching the DB volume.
nodes.languageNotes: Ports are intentionally de-conflicted from a sibling nepocorp project (silversea-* container names); demo deploy SSHes to root@vantai.tingting.vip and runs drizzle-kit migrate before cutover.

nodes.name: design-qa.md
nodes.summary: Visual QA report for the governance-actions compact-row redesign: compares source request images against rendered desktop/mobile captures, records an iterative fix history (textarea -> input, conditional decision controls, compact mobile metadata columns), and concludes with a passing result and the primary interactions tested.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml
nodes.summary: Local dev infrastructure compose file spinning up the silversea-* services: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 (Postgres 16 with the vector extension required by the FAQ fast-lane cosine index) on 5441, redis:7-alpine on 6391, and adminer on 8083, with a persistent silversea-pgdata volume and health checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pgvector image specifically because the stock postgres:16-alpine lacks the vector extension; container names are silversea-namespaced to run alongside a sibling nepocorp stack.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root pnpm workspace manifest for the 'tingting' monorepo. Defines thin npm scripts that delegate to Make targets (dev, setup, build) plus context-generation tooling, declares puppeteer as a dependency, and pins pnpm overrides for transitive security/compat patches (esbuild, undici, uuid, babel, js-yaml, protobufjs, etc.).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pnpm 'overrides' to force-resolve vulnerable/outdated transitive versions across the workspace.

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace definition declaring the frontend, backend, and shared packages plus the allowBuilds/onlyBuiltDependencies lists gating native build scripts for esbuild, protobufjs, puppeteer, and sharp.

nodes.name: repomix-output.xml
nodes.summary: Large machine-generated repomix XML dump (1.3M lines) concatenating the entire repository source for offline LLM ingestion. Not authored content; treat as a generated artifact rather than a hand-maintained source file.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript compilerOptions base inherited by every workspace package: ES2022 target, ESNext module with bundler resolution, strict mode, esModuleInterop, sourceMap, resolveJsonModule, and isolatedModules.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Example environment configuration for the SilverSea backend, documenting 22 runtime variables covering server port, Postgres/Redis connections, JWT auth, OCR providers (Gemini/OpenRouter), Bách Khoa GPS tracking, Map4D geocoding, web-push VAPID keys, and the command-and-insight bot toggle.
nodes.languageNotes: Dotenv-style KEY=value pairs with extensive inline comments; some values (model names, base URLs) are intentionally hardcoded in code rather than env, as noted in the file.

nodes.name: backend/Dockerfile.dockerignore
nodes.summary: Build-context allowlist for the backend Docker image: deny-everything by default then re-admit only the package.json/tsconfig/workspace files plus shared and backend source trees that the Dockerfile actually COPYs.

nodes.name: backend/Makefile
nodes.summary: Backend dev/release Makefile with targets to build and push the multi-arch backend image to GHCR (ghcr.io/4rankng/transting-backend) via docker buildx, plus link-orphan-drivers dry-run and --apply maintenance tasks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a docker-container buildx driver named 'bb' and computes a source tag via scripts/release-source-tag.mjs.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for the @tingting/backend workspace package, defining ESM scripts (dev, build, db migrations via drizzle-kit, seed, test) and pinning runtime dependencies including Express 5, Drizzle ORM, Casbin, Socket.IO, OpenTelemetry, web-push, and AI/OCR SDKs.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM package ("type": "module"); scripts chain a shared-package prebuild step and run tsx-based dev/test plus a post-build ESM import fixer.

nodes.name: backend/tsconfig.build.json
nodes.summary: Production TypeScript build config that extends the dev tsconfig and excludes test/spec files (src/tests, *.test.ts, *.spec.ts) from the compiled dist output.

nodes.name: backend/tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Backend TypeScript compiler config extending the monorepo tsconfig.base.json, emitting to dist/ from src/ with declarations disabled.

nodes.name: 00-cross-cutting.md
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting regression test cases (Vietnamese, TC-HT-*) shared across all modules: language/terminology, direct-URL authorization, audit logging, double-submit integrity, and other invariants that every surface must satisfy.

nodes.name: 01-module-01-overview-dispatch.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 1 (Tổng quan & Điều vận chuyến xe — overview and trip dispatch, Vietnamese): TC-M01-* cases covering the revenue/cost/profit and trip-count dashboard, normal/empty/edge-case data states, and view-permission controls.

nodes.name: 02-module-02-pricing-revenue.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 2 (Báo giá cước và doanh thu phi vận tải — pricing and non-operating revenue, Vietnamese): TC-M02-* cases for fixed price tables by customer/route, missing/wrong data handling, exception flows (editing suggested price before close requires a reason), and operation-permission controls.

nodes.name: 03-module-03-cus.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 3 (CUS — customer service, shipments, debit notes, and customer portal, Vietnamese): TC-M03-* cases covering booking intake and shipment-profile creation, minimal-data shipments, drafts without container numbers, multi-container shipments, and duplicate-profile detection.

nodes.name: 04-module-04-disbursement-recovery.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 4 (Quy trình chi hộ — thu hộ khép kín — closed-loop pay-on-behalf/recover, Vietnamese): TC-M04-* cases where CUS or a document clerk initiates a shipment, with normal-flow, missing/wrong-data, exception (drafts cannot incur costs or advance state), and operation-permission scenarios.

nodes.name: 05-module-05-ar.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 5 (Công nợ phải thu — AR / accounts receivable, Vietnamese): TC-M05-* cases for tracking customer balances by debit note or invoice, normal display/calculation, missing-data states, edge values (payment equals balance, debit-note cancellation before/after collection), and change/exception/permission rules (no direct balance edits).

nodes.name: 06-module-06-ap.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 6 (Quản lý công nợ phải trả — AP / accounts payable, Vietnamese): TC-M06-* cases centered on fuel-debt tracking, including normal flows, missing/wrong data, and exceptions (liter discrepancies and adjustment invoices must be explained).

nodes.name: 07-module-07-payroll.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 7 (Quản lý lương, chấm công và nhân sự lái xe — driver payroll and attendance, Vietnamese): TC-M07-* cases for per-trip pay calculation, base salary and standby days, missing/wrong data, edge cases (driver swaps trucks, trips spanning two periods, mid-month resignation), and post-close unlock/adjustment exceptions.

nodes.name: 08-module-08-driver-app.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 8 (Ứng dụng dành cho lái xe — driver mobile app, Vietnamese): TC-M08-* cases for a phone-readable, easy-to-operate UI, covering normal data display, empty states, and edge cases (landscape rotation, OS large font, slow network).

nodes.name: 09-module-09-field-app.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 9 (Ứng dụng trường — forwarder/field mobile app, Vietnamese): TC-M09-* cases for advances and pay-on-behalf on mobile, including the propose→receive→pay→reconcile flow, missing required-data handling, the multiple-advances-per-shipment-plus-balance-return exception, and maker-checker plus direct-URL permission controls.

nodes.name: 10-module-10-clerk-app.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 10 (Ứng dụng nhân viên chứng từ — document clerk app, Vietnamese): TC-M10-* cases for quick after-hours shipment creation on mobile, including successful draft creation, missing required field (customer), the connection-loss resubmit-without-duplicates exception, and role gating (only CLERK/ADMIN can access).

nodes.name: 11-module-11-finance-pnl.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 11 (Tài chính, Báo cáo lãi lỗ & Trợ lý giám đốc — finance, P&L reporting, and director assistant, Vietnamese): TC-M11-* cases for period P&L reporting, missing/wrong data (open-period warning, missing trip costs), retroactive-adjustment exceptions after period reopen, and operation-permission controls.

nodes.name: 12-module-12-fuel.md
nodes.summary: Regression test plan for PRD Module 12 (Nhiên liệu & Số hóa chứng từ dầu — fuel and fuel-voucher digitization, Vietnamese): TC-M12-* cases for fuel-norm and route-distance configuration, normal flows, missing/wrong data, edge values (multi-leg routes, loaded+empty trips, mid-month norm changes), and exceptions (editing actual liters requires a reason; mountain routes use flat-rate).

nodes.name: 13-customer-service-finance-visual-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Visual regression test specification covering the end-to-end Customer Service to Finance workflow, organized into 13 sections with 60+ test cases (VIS-CSF-001..608) spanning booking/CUS handover, AR debit notes, AP & treasury, profit dashboards, responsive/accessibility, RBAC matrix, and reporting templates.
nodes.languageNotes: Documented in Vietnamese with English/ASCII test IDs and CASBIN-style role tags (CLERK, ACCOUNTANT); each test case is tagged with priority (P0-P2) and mode ([READ]/[MUTATION]/Smoke).

nodes.name: CreditOverrideQueuePage

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized application configuration loader that parses environment variables (Postgres, Redis, JWT, feature flags, trust proxy) into a validated, typed `config` object consumed across the backend.

nodes.name: redis.ts
nodes.summary: Redis client wrapper and cache-aside utilities: provides a lazily-initialized singleton client, versioned cache-get with in-flight de-duplication, pattern-based invalidation, report cache busting, and JWT token blacklisting for session revocation.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a versioned cache (cacheVersions Map) plus inflightCacheRequests promise de-duplication to avoid thundering-herd DB hits.

nodes.name: getRedis
nodes.summary: Returns the lazily-initialized singleton Redis client, creating and wiring error logging on first access.

nodes.name: disconnectRedis
nodes.summary: Gracefully quits the Redis client connection if it has been initialized.

nodes.name: cacheGet
nodes.summary: Versioned cache-aside getter: returns cached JSON if present and version matches, otherwise invokes the fetch function and writes the result back with a TTL, de-duplicating concurrent identical fetches via an in-flight promise map.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidate
nodes.summary: Bumps the version counter and deletes a specific cache key, cancelling any in-flight fetch for that key so the next read repopulates from the DB.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidatePattern
nodes.summary: Scans Redis for keys matching a glob pattern and deletes them in batches, wrapped in a promise over scanStream events.

nodes.name: invalidateReportCaches
nodes.summary: Bulk cache-busting helper that clears the aging/receivables report cache keys and several pattern-based report namespaces in parallel.

nodes.name: isTokenBlacklisted
nodes.summary: Checks whether a JWT id (jti) has been revoked by testing for its presence in the Redis blacklist, swallowing and logging connection errors.

nodes.name: blacklistToken
nodes.summary: Adds a JWT id (jti) to the Redis blacklist with a TTL matching the token's remaining lifetime to enforce session revocation.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication and user-management Express router: implements login, /me profile, logout (JWT blacklisting), change-password, and admin CRUD for users and business units, with optimistic-concurrency locking, idempotency keys, Casbin authorization, and audit-event registration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses inline asyncHandler route handlers (not captured as named functions by tree-sitter) plus shared helpers for row-version locking, idempotency key resolution, and token revocation.

nodes.name: lockRowVersion
nodes.summary: Generic optimistic-concurrency guard that runs a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE lookup inside a transaction and throws an ApiError when the row is missing or its updatedAt timestamp differs from the expected value.

nodes.name: lockUserVersion
nodes.summary: Specialization of lockRowVersion for the users table that selects the non-deleted user's updatedAt with FOR UPDATE for safe profile/password updates.

nodes.name: lockBusinessUnitVersion
nodes.summary: Specialization of lockRowVersion for the business_units table used to guard business-unit create/update/deactivate commands against concurrent writes.

nodes.name: billing-documents.routes.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of asyncHandler-wrapped route handlers delegating to dedicated service modules for lifecycle and governance concerns.

nodes.name: payments.routes.ts

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: loadGovernanceActionKind
nodes.summary: Loads the actionKind of a governance action by id from the governanceActions table, throwing an ApiError when not found.

nodes.name: getRequestIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Resolves an idempotency key for a payment request, preferring a client-supplied header and falling back to a payload-derived key.

nodes.name: toCustomerDebitNote

nodes.name: toCustomerShipmentDetail

nodes.name: parsePositiveId
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a positive integer id parameter, throwing a validation error for non-positive or non-integer values.

nodes.name: resolveSelectedCustomerId

nodes.name: getOwnDebitNote

nodes.name: trips.ts

nodes.languageNotes: invalidateReportCaches helper fans out Redis cache invalidations across dashboard/PnL/aging keys whenever a trip write occurs.

nodes.name: accounting-transport-register.service.ts
nodes.summary: Service that builds the accounting transport register export by composing a complex Drizzle query across trips, financial postings, profitability snapshots, POD submissions, and carrier/container projections, with filter fingerprinting for caching.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Drizzle SQL template literals, subquery projections (containerProjection, carrierPayableProjection), and a canonicalFilter + sha256 fingerprint for stable caching.

nodes.name: getExpectedVersion
nodes.summary: Extracts and validates an expected optimistic-concurrency version integer from a trip request body, returning undefined when absent.

nodes.name: getRequiredGovernanceReason
nodes.summary: Reads and trims a required governance reason string from a request body, throwing a validation error when blank.

nodes.name: invalidateReportCaches
nodes.summary: Fan-outs Redis cache invalidations for dashboard, executive, entity-results, fuel-variance, and (optionally) PnL report keys after a trip write, swallowing errors.

nodes.name: canonicalFilter
nodes.summary: Normalizes the accounting-transport filter input (sorting/trimming arrays) into a canonical shape used for cache fingerprinting.

nodes.name: buildAccountingTransportFilterFingerprint
nodes.summary: Computes a deterministic sha256 fingerprint of the canonical filter, used as the cache key for the accounting transport register response.

nodes.name: conditionsFor
nodes.summary: Translates an accounting-transport filter input into an array of Drizzle WHERE conditions covering ids, dates, ownership, carriers, routes, shipments, and free-text plate/trip-code ilikes.

nodes.name: normalizeStringArray
nodes.summary: Normalizes an unknown value into a trimmed, deduplicated array of non-empty strings.

nodes.name: listAccountingTransportRows
nodes.summary: Executes the paginated, multi-join accounting transport register query (trips, postings, profitability, POD, carrier, containers) and shapes each row into the export payload, computing a total count and filter fingerprint.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes two large Drizzle select queries (data + count) over the same join graph and post-processes rows with readiness/string normalization helpers.

nodes.name: trip-command.service.ts

nodes.name: createTripCommand

nodes.name: copyTripCommand

nodes.name: dispatchTripCommand
nodes.summary: Dispatches a trip, transitioning status and emitting the dispatch notification.

nodes.summary: Idempotent write command that creates a trip, invalidates report caches, and emits notifications via injected deps.

nodes.name: copyTripWriteCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent write command that copies a source trip into a new trip with cache invalidation.

nodes.name: transitionTripWriteCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent write command that transitions a trip status, syncing attendance and invalidating caches.

nodes.name: dispatchTripWriteCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent write command that dispatches a trip with optional driver assignment and cache invalidation.

nodes.name: q23-direct-money-idempotency.test.ts

nodes.name: seedVendorPayable

nodes.name: postJson
nodes.summary: HTTP helper wrapping node http.request that posts JSON with auth + optional idempotency key, tracks created governance ids and returns a promise resolving to status code and parsed body.

nodes.name: fetchLedgerCount

nodes.name: fetchPenaltyLedgerCounts

nodes.name: fetchNotificationCount
nodes.summary: Counts notification rows for a related entity and tracks newly seen notification ids for assertion.

nodes.name: fetchNotificationRecipients
nodes.summary: Returns the ordered list of (notification id, userId) recipients for a related entity to assert exactly-once notification dispatch.

nodes.name: fetchVendorAudit
nodes.summary: Queries auditLogs payload JSON for vendor-payment rows matching a receiptId and tracks the audit ids for assertion.

nodes.name: fetchCarrierAudit
nodes.summary: Queries auditLogs payload JSON for carrier-payment rows matching a receiptId and tracks the audit ids for assertion.

nodes.name: fetchPenaltyCancelAudit
nodes.summary: Queries auditLogs payload JSON for penalty-cancel rows matching a reason and tracks the audit ids for assertion.

nodes.name: checkGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: POSTs a governance-action check request for an action id/version/actor and returns the response.

nodes.name: approveGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: POSTs a governance-action approval request for an action id/version/actor and returns the response.

nodes.name: advanceGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Drives a governance action from its current version through check and approve, asserting version increments and tracking the resulting governance action id.

nodes.name: q23-upload-idempotency.test.ts

nodes.name: report-cache-invalidation.test.ts

nodes.name: shared-runtime-contract.test.ts

nodes.name: treasury-route-idempotency.test.ts

nodes.name: workflow-capabilities.test.ts

nodes.name: buildPhotoForm

nodes.name: uploadPhoto

nodes.name: uploadCompanyLogo

nodes.name: persistOcrPhoto
nodes.summary: Submits an OCR photo persist request with an idempotency key and returns the parsed response, used to verify OCR upload idempotency.

nodes.name: post

nodes.name: aging.service.ts
nodes.summary: Receivables/payables aging service computing FIFO aging buckets from the ledger, with Redis caching, Vietnam as-of cutoff resolution, customer-search matching, pagination, and historical report checksums/version metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Drizzle ORM query builders with dynamic condition arrays; relies on resolveVietnamAsOfCutoff for consistent historical reporting.

nodes.name: historicalReportMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds versioned metadata for a historical report, including definition version, Vietnam as-of cutoff timestamps, and a SHA-256 checksum of the payload for cache integrity.

nodes.name: fetchLedgerGrouped
nodes.summary: Queries the ledger table with configurable filters (entity types, txn types, account types, cutoff date) and groups debit/credit rows by entity id, summing balances.

nodes.name: computeAging
nodes.summary: Computes FIFO aging buckets for a set of ledger entries as of a reference date, optionally inverting signs for payable/credit treatment.

nodes.name: computeEntityResults
nodes.summary: Aggregates aging results per entity by computing bucketed balances and days-overdue from grouped ledger entries relative to the reference date.

nodes.name: getEntityResultsCached
nodes.summary: Fetches and computes entity aging results behind a Redis cacheGet layer, keying by scope config (txn types, entity types, account types) and Vietnam as-of cutoff.

nodes.name: paginateAgingRows
nodes.summary: Applies offset/limit pagination to a list of aging rows and returns the page slice along with total count and page metadata.

nodes.name: findCustomerIdsForAgingSearch
nodes.summary: Resolves free-text customer search terms to a set of customer ids by matching customer names, trip container numbers, and trip expense fee descriptions.

nodes.name: getReceivablesSummary
nodes.summary: Computes the receivables aging summary across active customers using customer receivable snapshots, building bucket totals, overdue percentage, and historical report metadata.

nodes.name: getTopOverdueCustomer
nodes.summary: Identifies the customer with the largest overdue receivable balance from receivable snapshots and returns it with the customer display name.

nodes.name: getCustomerAgingList
nodes.summary: Produces a paginated list of customer aging rows with names, contacts, and linked-supplier payable netting, applying optional search filters and historical report metadata.

nodes.name: getPayablesForScope
nodes.summary: Computes payable aging items for a given scope (carrier or vendor), enriching each entry with supplier/carrier display details via batched lookups.

nodes.name: mergePayablesSummaries
nodes.summary: Merges multiple payable summary results into one, deduplicating items by entity id and summing bucket balances.

nodes.name: getPayablesSummary
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point for payable aging reports; resolves category-specific scopes (fuel, ancillary, commission, carrier), computes scopes in parallel, merges them, and attaches historical report metadata.

nodes.name: pnl.service.ts

nodes.name: recordedTripRevenue

nodes.name: getFuelVarianceReport

tour.title: Project Overview & Working Contract
tour.description: Start with AGENTS.md, the mandatory working contract for every coding agent in the Silversea repo, to learn the trunk-based development rules and required skills. Then read CONTEXT.md for the stable repository layout (shared/backend/frontend/e2e/docs/deploy), the source-authority order, and the core invariants (Drizzle-only persistence, rounding rules). Together these orient you to how TingTing, the Vietnamese trucking-logistics platform, is built and contributed to before any code.

tour.title: Shared Contracts & Domain Vocabulary
tour.description: The shared/src package is the lingua franca between backend and frontend. Its barrel index re-exports the domain enums, status labels, type definitions, and feature-permission constants used everywhere. The deterministic trip-costing engine in calculations/tripTotals.ts (fuel, road allowance, tolls, VAT-adjusted revenue, gross profit) and the governance source-authority helpers are prime examples of business logic that lives here precisely so both tiers can't drift apart.
tour.languageLesson: A TypeScript 'barrel' file uses `export * from './module'` to re-export many modules through one entry point, giving consumers a clean public API surface while keeping internal paths private.

tour.title: Database Schema & Migrations
tour.description: The Postgres schema is the backbone of the platform. drizzle.config.ts points Drizzle Kit at db/schema.ts, which declares every pg enum (trip status, roles, advance/credit-override/governance states) and all table objects. The 170+ migration files in backend/drizzle/ evolve that schema incrementally; 0000 introduces the foundational trips/customers/ledger tables, while later migrations like 0135 add governance_actions. Reading these reveals the full entity model the services in later steps operate on.
tour.languageLesson: Drizzle migrations are append-only and ordered by filename prefix. Each file applies one incremental, reversible change so the database can evolve alongside code without rebuilds.

tour.title: Backend Bootstrap & Core Foundation
tour.description: backend/src/index.ts is the Express entry point: it wires every route module, the auth/Casbin/audit/error middleware, the database and Redis clients, telemetry, and the scheduler into a running server. Around it sit the highest-fan-in files in the whole codebase — db/index.ts (the Drizzle client, imported 302 times), errors.ts (the ApiError type thrown across the API), config/index.ts, and lib/redis.ts. Understanding this layer explains how a request begins its journey.

tour.title: Authorization: Casbin RBAC Model
tour.description: TingTing enforces role-based access control with Casbin. model.conf declares the policy model, policy.csv grants permission tuples to each role (ADMIN wildcard down to DRIVER, CUSTOMER, FORWARDER), and the enforcer singleton loads them at boot. The casbin.ts middleware turns those policies into Express guards — including a trip-specific wrapper that relaxes close-maker checks on completion endpoints. This is why an accountant and a driver see entirely different surfaces.
tour.languageLesson: Casbin decouples authorization logic from code: the model file defines HOW policies are matched (e.g. RBAC with subjects/objects/actions), while the CSV defines WHO can do WHAT. Changing permissions becomes a data edit, not a deploy.

tour.title: Backend API Layer: Routes & Middleware
tour.description: Every HTTP request flows through a middleware chain — asyncHandler, auth (JWT, the second-most-imported file), and errorHandler — before reaching a route. The routes range from auth.ts (login/session) to trips.ts and the financial/ sub-router family. utils/crud-factory.ts is the workhorse: it generates standard list/create/get/update/delete endpoints for any Drizzle table with soft-delete, search, pagination, idempotency, and cache invalidation, so most resources get a REST surface for free.

tour.title: Backend Services: Shipments, Trips & Finance
tour.description: This is the business heart of the platform. shipment.service.ts handles shipment CRUD with optimistic locking and an append-only status-transition state machine; trip.service.ts barrels the trip-domain services (queries, mutations, status machine); financial.service.ts covers payments, payouts, ledger entries, and penalties. These services consume the shared calculations from Step 2 and write against the schema from Step 3, so this is where the domain rules actually live.

tour.title: Governance & the LLM Agent
tour.description: Two cross-cutting subsystems elevate the platform beyond CRUD. governance-policy.ts defines which governance actions exist, what evidence they require, and which roles may make/check/approve them — the same concepts encoded in the q18 migrations. The agent lane (orchestrator.ts runs the LLM tool-use loop; intent-router.ts classifies each user message into summary/financial-overview/lookup/report/navigation or LLM fallback) is served over the socket.io transport in agentSocket.ts, streaming AG-UI protocol events to the chatbot UI.

tour.title: LLM Providers & Scheduled Jobs
tour.description: The agent and other AI features run against pluggable LLM providers. provider-registry.ts returns the active chat provider (MiniMax/OpenAI/OpenRouter) from settings, while openai-runner.ts executes the actual model call. Separately, scheduler/runner.ts boots each registered job onto node-cron and runs ticks under a Postgres advisory lock with retries and scheduler_run_logs bookkeeping — this is how snapshots, GPS capture, and retention jobs fire reliably.

tour.title: Frontend Client: API & Auth Hooks
tour.description: Crossing to the frontend, lib/api builds the fetch client and session token handling, while api/keys.ts holds the central TanStack Query key registry (qk) consumed by every data hook. useAuth.tsx provides the AuthProvider with token lifecycle and offline-safe JWT revocation queueing. These modules are the bridge that turns the backend REST surface from Step 6 into typed, cached, authenticated data the UI can render.

tour.title: Frontend UI: App Shell & Design System
tour.description: main.tsx bootstraps the React/Vite SPA and App.tsx wires the global providers (auth, search, month, reduced-motion, agent directives) and lazily mounts the entire route tree with role/capability guards. The shared design-system barrel and the Layout component give every page a consistent shell. Notice App.tsx is the frontend's top fan-out hub — it is where routing, RBAC, and feature composition meet.

tour.title: Feature Pages & Components
tour.description: With the shell understood, the feature pages show the platform's breadth: DashboardPage composes financial KPIs, receivables warnings, fleet utilization and profitability; TripListPage aggregates a month of trips with status/KPI cards; DispatchPage drives the live fleet view. Underneath, UI.tsx (the most-imported frontend component) and the trip component cluster provide the reusable building blocks. searchRegistry.ts powers the command palette that jumps between all of these.

tour.title: Tests, E2E & Infrastructure
tour.description: The tour closes with quality and delivery. The backend Vitest suite (e.g. q23-trip-idempotency.test.ts) and frontend route/component tests (e.g. DispatchPage.test.tsx) guard behavior, while e2e/test_15_customer_portal.py covers end-to-end flows. The root Makefile orchestrates local dev and the three-stage demo deploy; the multi-stage backend and frontend Dockerfiles package each app into a minimal image, with docker-compose.dev.yml tying Postgres and Redis together for local development.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds use multiple FROM statements: a builder stage carries dev dependencies for compiling TypeScript, while the final stage copies only runtime artifacts into a slim Alpine image — often cutting image size by 50-80%.
